title: Quarterly cash-tax and estimated-payment forecast
prompt:
Prepare Alder Ridge's federal and state estimated-payment forecast for the next four quarters.

Use the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition correspondence, the v4 controller-review workpapers, the current jurisdiction and book-detail export, the tax review notes, and the signed reporting policy. Treat the v2 pre-close workbook as change history only.

Start with the approved federal and state taxable-income forecast for each quarter, not the book provision. Calculate each federal and state payment separately under the estimated-payment policy. Apply the federal and state safe-harbor percentages to pre-credit tax, then subtract the applicable quarterly credits. Apply the opening federal prepaid balance and opening state payable balance only to the first forecast-quarter payments.

Reconcile the full-rate forecast tax liability before safe-harbor reductions to the opening positions and all eight estimated payments. Report a positive ending balance as tax payable and a negative balance as prepaid tax.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `q3_federal_payment`, `q3_state_payment`, `q4_federal_payment`, `q4_state_payment`, `q1_federal_payment`, `q1_state_payment`, `q2_federal_payment`, `q2_state_payment`, `twelve_month_cash_tax`, `ending_tax_payable_prepaid`. Use dollar amounts to two decimals.
